documents.title: Baking powder
documents.summary: A dry mixture used to make batters and doughs rise.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Baking powder is a dry chemical leavening agent made from a base, a weak acid, and usually a starch.

sections.heading: Use
sections.text: It releases carbon dioxide and increases the volume and lightness of baked goods.
